_description: Play chipless online backgammon with SogeGammon. No chips needed to sit at the table: live matches with real opponents, a free tournament every 3 hours, ranked leaderboards, friend invites. Web and Android.
_keywords: SogeGammon, backgammon, online backgammon, chipless backgammon, live backgammon, play backgammon, tournament, tavla, Sogepps
hero_lead: No need to stockpile chips to sit at the table. Live backgammon matches with real opponents, a free tournament every 3 hours, ranked leaderboards and friend invites. Play with the same account from your browser or your phone.
how_desc: Create your account, start a match, roll your dice. Anyone who knows the rules is in their first match within a minute.
how_1_d: Sign in with email or your Google account in seconds. The same account works on web and mobile.
how_2_d: Join the queue and we'll match you with a player near your level, or send a friend an invite link.
how_3_d: Roll the dice and drag your checkers. Playable points are highlighted on the board; the timer and score stay on top.
how_4_d: Your rating grows as you win, moving you up the leaderboard. Gammons and backgammons count extra toward your score.
feat_desc: The rules of classic backgammon, with a modern online experience.
f_1_d: No chips needed to sit at the table. Losing doesn't get you kicked out; you jump straight into a new match.
f_2_d: Instant connection with real opponents: dice, moves and chat flow on both sides at the same time.
f_3_d: Entry is free for tournaments starting every 3 hours. Survive the eliminations and take the cup.
f_4_d: Every match counts toward your rating; measure yourself against real opponents on the leaderboard.
f_5_d: Add friends, share an invite link, and challenge them. Tapping the link drops them straight at the table.
f_6_d: Choose your look, from a classic green felt to wooden boards and flame or neon dice effects.
f_7_d: Add color to your matches with pets sitting next to your name and gifts sent to your opponent.
f_8_d: Play against a bot whenever you don't want to wait for an opponent, and comfortably work on your opening moves.
modes_desc: Play as long as you like: three formats from a quick single-point match to a long series.
arts_desc: Guides and game ideas around SogeGammon (in Turkish).
cta_desc: The online backgammon game from the Sogepps app family. Try it right away in your browser, take it with you on Android.
